'''Rasz Kal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] and a minor [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Jyvus Space City]], the largest [[City-ship/Legends|city-ship]] in orbit over [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. He once bought an [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]] at [[Gorn's Emporium]], but it malfunctioned and Rasz threatened [[Gorn Vorrox]], the owner of the store.<ref name="SoF" />
